break.first_bit: Do the first tiny bit of “{{title}}”
break.next: Keep going with the next part
break.wrap: Wrap up and put things away

explain.plain: “{{quest}}” is a good place to start.

sync.state_guest: Guest: your data stays on this device
sync.state_offline: Offline: changes will sync when you are back online
sync.error_hint: Your changes are safe on this device. Questline keeps trying, or tap Sync now.

choice.title: This device has its own progress
choice.body: Your account already has quests and rewards, and so does this device. Choose what to keep. Nothing changes until you confirm.
choice.merge_hint: Keep everything from your account and this device. Rewards earned in both places count once.
choice.keep_account_hint: Use what is in your account. This device's quests and rewards are removed from this device.
choice.keep_device_hint: Replace your account's data with this device's. Your other devices will switch to it too.
choice.warn_device: This device's own progress will be removed.
choice.warn_account: Your account's current progress will be replaced on every device.
choice.done_merge: Merged. Everything is in your account now.
choice.done_keep_account: Your account's data is on this device now.
choice.done_keep_device: Your account now holds this device's data.
choice.failed: That did not work. Your data is unchanged; please try again.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Optional. Questline works fully without one.
account.link_error: That link did not work. It may have expired or been used already. Please try again.
account.unconfigured_title: Accounts are not set up yet
account.unconfigured_body: This copy of Questline runs as a guest. Everything works and your data stays safely on this device.
account.why_sync: Your quests and rewards on all your devices, synced in moments
account.why_ai: AI helpers that break tasks into tiny steps
account.why_calendar: Google Calendar: due dates and focus blocks, plus your free time
account.why_reminders: Reminders on your phone or computer
account.guest_ok: No account? No problem. Everything else works on this device.
account.mode_label: Sign in or create an account
account.invalid_email: That email address does not look complete.
account.reset_body: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
account.check_email_confirm: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
account.check_email_reset: If {{email}} has an account, a reset link is on its way.
account.sign_out_note: Signing out removes your account's data from this device (it stays safe in your account) and starts a fresh guest space here. Language and appearance stay.
account.unsynced_body_one: {{count}} change has not reached your account yet, so signing out now would lose it. You can stay signed in and try again when you are online.
account.unsynced_body_other: {{count}} changes have not reached your account yet, so signing out now would lose them. You can stay signed in and try again when you are online.
account.error_invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match. Please try again.
account.error_email_not_confirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox for our link.
account.error_user_exists: There is already an account with that email. Try signing in.
account.error_weak_password: Please choose a longer or less common password.
account.error_rate_limited: Too many tries for now. Please wait a minute.
account.error_offline: You seem to be offline. Please try again when you are connected.
account.error_unconfigured: Accounts are not set up in this copy of Questline.
account.error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

ai.unavailable_guest_hint: Sign in to let AI sort your list into quests. You can still add them line by line below.
ai.unavailable_offline_hint: You can still turn each line into a quest now.
ai.unavailable_unconfigured: AI is not set up yet
ai.unavailable_unconfigured_hint: The AI helpers have not been switched on for this Questline. Everything else works.
ai.unavailable_limit_reached: Today's AI helps are used up
ai.unavailable_limit_reached_hint: They come back tomorrow. You can still turn each line into a quest.
ai.failed: The AI could not answer this time. Please try again.
ai.go_to_account: Sign in or create an account
ai.unavailable_off_hint: You switched them off in settings, so nothing is sent anywhere. You can still turn each line into a quest.

brain_dump.title: Brain dump
brain_dump.subtitle: Empty your head. Sort it out after.
brain_dump.label: Everything on your mind
brain_dump.placeholder: Paste or type anything, one thing per line or all mixed up…
brain_dump.too_long: That is a lot! Please shorten it a little or split it into two dumps.
brain_dump.nothing_found: No tasks found in that text.
brain_dump.review_hint_one: Here is {{n}} quest. Change anything, remove what you do not need, then save.
brain_dump.review_hint_other: Here are {{n}} quests. Change anything, remove what you do not need, then save.

calendar.title: Day plan
calendar.subtitle: See your free time and plan a focus block in it.
calendar.connected_as: Connected to Google Calendar {{email}}. Quests with due dates and your focus blocks appear in a calendar named Questline.
calendar.explain_guest_hint: Sign in to connect Google Calendar. You can still plan focus blocks here on this device.
calendar.explain_unconfigured: Google Calendar is not set up yet
calendar.explain_unconfigured_hint: Calendar sync has not been switched on for this Questline. You can still plan focus blocks here.
calendar.explain_disconnected_hint: Connect Google Calendar to see your events here and to add your due dates and focus blocks to a calendar named Questline.
calendar.explain_checking_hint: One moment. You can plan focus blocks in the meantime.
calendar.result_denied: No problem, Google Calendar stays disconnected.
calendar.result_error: Google Calendar could not connect. Please try again.
calendar.load_failed: Your Google events could not load right now.
calendar.nothing_planned: Nothing planned yet. The whole day is open.
calendar.no_gaps: No free gaps left today. Rest counts too.
calendar.no_quests: Add a quest first, then plan time for it here.

reminders.due_soon_hint: A gentle heads-up before a quest is due.
reminders.nudge_hint: One friendly nudge a day at a time you choose.
reminders.paused_hint: If you leave a focus session paused for 15 minutes.
reminders.quiet_hint: No reminders in this window; due-soon ones wait until it ends.
reminders.push_hint: Reminders arrive even when Questline is closed.
reminders.push_denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings. Reminders still show inside Questline.
reminders.push_unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications when Questline is closed. Reminders still show inside the app.
reminders.push_unconfigured: Phone and computer notifications are not set up yet. Reminders still show inside the app.
reminders.push_guest: Sign in to get reminders when Questline is closed.
reminders.push_failed: Notifications could not be switched on. Please try again.
reminders.permission_denied: Notifications are blocked, so reminders will show inside Questline only.
reminders.in_app_only: Reminders show inside Questline while it is open. With an account they can also reach you when it is closed.
reminders.due_soon_body: “{{quest}}” is due soon. One small step is enough.
reminders.nudge_body: Pick one tiny step. Starting is the win.
reminders.paused_body: “{{quest}}” is waiting where you left it.

settings.guest_body: You are using Questline as a guest. Your data stays on this device.
settings.sign_in: Sign in or create an account
settings.ai_ready_hint: Break quests into tiny steps, sort a brain dump and more.
settings.reminders_hint: All off by default except due-soon. Switch on only what helps.
settings.ai_switch_hint: When off, Questline never sends your tasks to the AI, and every AI button hides.

data.title: Your data
data.export_hint: A JSON file with every quest, step, reward and setting on this device.
data.delete_account_hint: Removes your account and everything in it, on every device.
data.delete_account_body: Your account and all its quests, rewards and settings are deleted for good, Google Calendar access is removed and reminders stop. This cannot be undone.
data.delete_account_done: Your account and its data are deleted.
data.erase_device_hint: Starts Questline fresh on this device.
data.erase_device_body: All quests, rewards and progress on this device are removed. Language and appearance stay. This cannot be undone.
data.delete_failed: That did not work. Nothing was deleted; please try again.
data.understand: I understand this cannot be undone
